approval: User architecture alignment brief 2026-10-22: global BUF publication, empty initialization, performance edits and bounded native memory reuse; user 2026-10-23 continuation: native two/four-bar LEN 32/64, bounded capture/publication/cancellation/FREEZE validation
target: OS 1.16 native BUF next-bar emulator; ONESHOT is the initial reader qualification
evidence_level: native input/worker/sequence/CPU-DSP execution with modeled peripherals and stock voice PCM

elekloader.role: optional future packaging and UI/control integration; not a build dependency

controls: Global recorder DEST or explicit Sketch BUF; next-bar ARM with R.LEN 16/32/64, automatic publication without assignment; existing FREEZE frontends retained
source_equivalence: Reuse stock recorder, loader, generation seats and publication; optional worker/commit emitters remove track dependence only in NextBarUI; default emitter bytes preserved

experiment.comparator: No native wrap notification must prevent capture/publication
experiment.tolerance: exact bytes with separately reported native service latency
experiment.retention: Fresh ignored runs, frozen sources, preserve failures

validation: Short focused instruction tests, empty-buffer selector and performance workflow, bounded release/reuse at integration
gaps: Normal 16-step clock only; shorter lengths, LEN 128 and MAX refuse. Existing ten-second capacity remains; overlong captures cancel without replacing accepted PCM. Publication timing is modeled, and physical timing, final output, broader playback/retirement, persistence and hardware remain open.
decisions: Native interrupt observes only; native GUI start/stop and stock background copy/load; no host scheduler

duration_extension.clock: Consecutive native first-step bar receipts, not host time
duration_extension.capacity: Existing 480000-frame maximum enforced with the native sample clock
